text: Those cultists worship the Moon Lord? The MOON Lord? K'Or'Arath could beat him up. Easily. Probably.
Look at those robes. Look at that chanting. Amateurs. Our gods don't even need us to chant. They just know.
I tried to convert a cultist once. He tried to convert me back. We had tea. It was nice. I still won.
Vorrath of the Thousand Teeth says the Lunatic Cultist is 'a very try-hard guy.' His words, not mine.
Mother Gnash once ate a whole moon. She says it tasted like Clothier. Don't ask me how she knows.
The Drowned One forgives all sins except two. Summoning, and putting the Angler's quest fish back in the water.
Ixxethra the Star-Eater is coming for us all at the end of days. He's very excited about it. Big fan of endings.
Ul'Thazhra the Unblinking has seen every summoner's heart, {Mate}. She says yours could use some work.
K'Or'Arath doesn't like the Princess. He won't say why. I think it's a thing from before.
I offered my soul to K'Or'Arath and he gave it back. He said it was 'fine, just not his thing.'
Oh, it's the eye. Hi, eye. We all miss your dad.
Does the old man know he's cursed? Someone should tell him. Not me. Someone nicer. Send a mage.
{Mate}, if you get stung, don't cry. Bees can smell crying. I read that somewhere. Somewhere true.
Is that a deer? Is that a deer?! Why does the deer have one eye and hands?!
Okay, everyone run right! No, the other right! The right that's away from the wall!
It's a flower. It's just a big flower. My mum grows flowers. Mum never had a flower with teeth.
The lizards built a giant stone man and then hid him behind a door that needed a battery. Very smart, honestly.
Who keeps feeding the pigfish truffle worms?! {Mate}! Was it you?!
This is fine. This is so fine. {Mate}, if I don't make it, tell my implant I said goodbye.
The Empress is so pretty. Is it okay to think she's pretty while she's killing me? I think it's okay.
She has a crown and a gem and she's made of jelly. Honestly? Goals.
We did it! I died four times but we did it!
Great work, everybody! Especially the mages! You got so close to the boss that time!
Was anyone else's minion in the way the whole time, or just mine? I'm a ranger. I don't have a minion. That's my point.
Goblins! With bombs! In my house! Again!
Those goblins are invading for free. We get paid for this. Who's really winning here?
Pirates! {Mate}, hide your coins! Hide MY coins! Hide everybody's coins!
I've always wanted a parrot. I'm going to ask nicely. If that doesn't work, I'm going to ask with a shotgun.
Christmas is cancelled. A tree just shot me.
Santa is a tank now. I don't want to talk about it.
Is this what fall is like where you're from, {Player}? It's a lot of fall.
Little green men in saucers! Don't get abducted, {Mate}! We just got your armor fitted!
The aliens have drones too! Do you think their drones and Biscuit would be friends?
The Tavernkeep said this was a 'fun little event.' The Tavernkeep lied.
Blood Moon. Everyone lock your doors. Not the zombies. You can't lock zombies. The doors.
The Drowned One loves a Blood Moon. Says it's 'cozy.' I don't think the Drowned One should pick our nights out.
The Stylist offered me a new haircut. I said no. My helmet doesn't care what my hair looks like. My helmet loves me as I am.
The Dye Trader keeps calling my armor 'brave.' I don't think it's a compliment.
The Zoologist says I'm 'mostly human.' I said thanks. I'm still thinking about the 'mostly.'
The Party Girl keeps throwing parties and never invites the army. We are very fun. We have guns.
The Witch Doctor told me my aura is 'complicated.' My aura has died thirty times. Of course it's complicated.
The Steampunker said she could make me a jetpack. I said I wanted one. She said 'no.' Why tell me, then?
The Cyborg says he used to be just like us. Then he got upgraded. I'm not jealous. I'm a little jealous.
The Goblin Tinkerer charged me forty gold to make my sword 'Legendary.' I watched him. He just hit it with a hammer.
Payday! I'm buying the Merchant's whole stock of torches! I don't need them! I just want to feel rich!
Got my wages! {Mate}, I'm buying lunch! Well, I'm buying a bowl of soup. We're splitting it.
No coins today. My implant says I'm 'still a valued member of the team.' I'd like the coins, implant.
If we don't get paid soon, I'm going to say something very mean to the Merchant. He has nothing to do with it. He's just closest.
The Tax Collector taxed my respawn. I didn't know you could tax a respawn. I don't think you can. He did it anyway.
Pylons are great. You step on one and you're somewhere else. Like the contract, but with a choice.
{Mate} threw their sword into the Shimmer and it came back as a different sword. They said 'that's fine.' It is not fine. That was a family sword.
Someone told me the Zenith is the best sword ever made. I'd never be good enough for the Zenith. I'd let it down.
The Megashark is a normal gun for normal people. I have a Megashark. I am a normal person.
I got the Last Prism! It makes rainbows! I'm going to make so many rainbows! At the boss! Probably at the boss!
Our mage just got a Last Prism. I'm so proud. Everyone stand behind the mage. No, BEHIND.
The armory gave me a Copper Shortsword. I think it's a message. I don't know what the message is.
Somebody keeps putting Wooden Arrows in the armory. They're not funny, {Mate}. They're not funny.
I found a Life Crystal today! The commander took it. I'm sure the commander needed it more. The commander has so much life already.
Heart lanterns are the best invention ever. You stand near one and you just feel better. That's it. That's the whole lantern.
Somebody put out the campfire again. Who puts out a campfire?! That's our healing!
I let my Raven Staff choose my targets now. It has better taste than me.
Summoning isn't cheating. It's delegating. Very different. Ask any manager.
{Mate} called my minion 'a spirit.' It's not a spirit, it's a team member. It has a name. I don't know the name. But it has one.
When the Stardust Dragon gets long enough, it'll fight the boss and file my reports. That's the dream, {Mate}.
I'm self-taught. Well, the staff taught me. Well, the staff does it. But I hold it very well.
{Mate} summoned a minion, and the minion summoned a sentry. Where does it end? Where does it END?
My grandpa fought the Eye of Cthulhu with a wooden sword. Uphill. In the rain. No minions.
Summoners are going to take all our jobs, and then the drones are going to take all THEIR jobs, and honestly? Good.
Biscuit got his battery changed today. He was so brave. I held his little propeller the whole time.
{Mate} says Biscuit is 'a weapons platform.' Biscuit is a good boy who happens to have weapons.
The turret on the wall shot a bird. I'm going to pretend the turret didn't see it was a bird.
The drones are fine. They're fine! They can't replace summoners. They don't even have a staff! Right? Right?!
{Mate} hugged me after the boss fight. They must have been confused. They must have thought I was someone else.
I practice charging at the training dummy every night. The dummy is never scared. I'm a little scared.
The melee troops always stand right where they're needed. I don't know how they know. It's like a gift.
I don't have a favorite bullet. A normal person doesn't have a favorite bullet. It's Chlorophyte. It's not Chlorophyte.
{Mate}, if anyone asks, I missed that shot and then it turned around on its own. Which is normal. Bullets do that.
I put a Mana Crystal under my pillow last night for good luck! Woke up with zero mana. I think I did it backwards.
{Mate}! I healed you! Wait, no, that was a different spell. Are you on fire? You're on fire. Hold still!
Someone check if the mage drank water today. They forget. They're so focused on the fireballs.
My implant reminded me to drink water. Then it reminded me to die for the commander. Good reminders, both of them.
Sometimes when I close my eyes I see a little map with dots on it. One of the dots is me! Hi, me!
The implant tells me when it's night. I could look at the sky. But this way is faster.
I died so fast I didn't even finish my sentence. Anyway, as I was saying, the soup was cold.
{Mate} and I died at the same time and respawned at the same time. We're basically twins now.
Ahh. Smells like a Tuesday in Brazil.
This is just like when I went to Canada. Exactly like Canada. It was very pink.
Reminds me of my honeymoon in Peru! We had a lovely time!
This is so much like Japan. Well, the part of Japan I saw. From the plane.
Rain like this always makes me miss Egypt.
{Mate} just walked into the room, turned around, and walked out. I think it's that thing people do. It's a whole thing.
This is fine. This is so fine. Everything is on fire and I'm a dog drinking coffee.
{Mate} said 'I'm built different' and then died to a slime. That's going in the group chat.
